title: Determine the Net Torque
text: What should the net torque be when the seesaw is balanced (in $$\text{N}\cdot\text{m})$$?

title: Calculate the Forces
text: Both weights point down. Take the torque from the first child's weight as negative and the torque from the second child's weight as positive.

title: Use the Torque Formula
text: Recall the formula for torque: $$\tau=rF\sin\theta.$$ Note that if child one sits $$x$$ meters away from the pivot, child two sits $$3.00-x$$ meters away from the pivot. Solve for $$x$$.
